title: Speculative Decoding and the Curse of Multilinguality
abstract: arXiv:2605.30580v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Speculative decoding is a popular technique for large language model (LLM) inference, enabling faster generation by drafting multiple tokens with a smaller draft model. However, the effectiveness of speculative decoding has mainly been studied for English. Motivated by the curse of multilinguality, we hypothesize that speculative decoding is far less effective for low-resource languages due to the limited multilingual capacities of smaller models. We test nine low-resource languages and four high-resource languages under a standard speculative decoding setup and find moderate evidence for our hypothesis.   Next, we try to improve the multilingual capabilities of the smaller draft model via distillation from the larger model. We find, though, that distillation generalizes poorly across tasks in the same language, and we argue that assembling a task-agnostic, fully representative dataset is infeasible for low-resource languages. Finall

translated_title: 推测解码与多语言诅咒
translated_abstract: 推测解码（speculative decoding）是大语言模型（LLM）推理中一种流行的技术，通过使用较小的草稿模型起草多个词元来实现更快的生成。然而，推测解码的有效性此前主要针对英语进行了研究。受“多语言诅咒”的启发，我们假设由于较小模型的多语言能力有限，推测解码在低资源语言上的效果要差得多。我们在标准推测解码设置下测试了九种低资源语言和四种高资源语言，并为我们的假设找到了适度的证据支持。接下来，我们尝试通过从较大模型进行蒸馏来提升较小草稿模型的多语言能力。然而，我们发现蒸馏在同一语言的不同任务之间泛化能力较差，并且我们认为为低资源语言构建一个与任务无关的、完全具有代表性的数据集是不可行的。最后……
tldr: 本研究验证了推测解码在低资源语言上的效果因小模型多语言能力有限而大打折扣，且通过蒸馏提升草稿模型多语言能力的方法因任务间泛化差以及低资源语言难以构建通用数据集而不可行。
en_tdlr: This study provides moderate evidence that speculative decoding is far less effective for low-resource languages due to the limited multilingual capacities of smaller draft models, and shows that distillation generalizes poorly across tasks, making it infeasible for low-resource languages where a task-agnostic representative dataset cannot be assembled.
